notes.title: New Update - Structures and Production
notes.content:
Hi, it's update day. We have a few specific changes. To sum it up, let's list all the changes:
1. We added abandoned cities around the portals. they can be destroyed and captured using a special unit.
2. The production system has been rebuilt. From now on, the maximum number of employees in the building is three, and they work more effectively when they have the tools provided.
3. To stimulate the economy, also check out research in which you will improve many aspects.
4. Production management has been improved, among other things, and you will probably find a few more new aspects.

As the world approaches, I would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year

notes.title: Unit Update
notes.content:
Hello. I've finished working on another update, this time it's about units but not only.
I added some enemies such as the Exploding Undead, Death and the Necromancer. You can also expect several allied units and teleportation, as well as a new resource and also some new graphics. I don't want to give any spoilers, so check it out for yourself.
If you want to see a more detailed report, check out my YouTube channel

I hope you will like the new attractions. Stay among the living. See you soon.

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content: Good morning, survivors. The first small update to our game is released today. It adds achievements. There are 9 of them. You will have fun getting them. If you have suggestions for new achievements, you can share them. Good luck in the fight. Bye
